Bangalore

Professional Summary
Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in designing and delivering automated test frameworks and CI-integrated test suites for high-traffic consumer platforms. Experienced in leading test strategy, improving test coverage, and reducing release cycle defects through robust automation and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Automation Testing, Java, TestNG, Cypress, JUnit, Jira, Agile, Git

Work Experience
Senior QA Automation Engineer, Swiggy (Oct 2018 - Apr 2026)
- Designed and maintained TestNG- and JUnit-based automation frameworks for order lifecycle and delivery orchestration, improving automated regression coverage by 65% and catching release-blocking issues before production.
- Built end-to-end Test Automation pipelines integrated with Git and CI to run parallel suites for critical user journeys, reducing nightly pipeline time by 40% and increasing pipeline reliability.
- Led test strategy in Agile sprints, authoring Jira test plans and coordinating with cross-functional teams to resolve defects, resulting in a 30% reduction in high-priority defects post-release.

QA Automation Engineer, Infosys (Nov 2016 - Sep 2018)
- Implemented Selenium- and Cypress-based UI automation for enterprise web applications using Java and JUnit, increasing automated test cases for core modules by 50%.
- Integrated automated suites with Git-backed CI jobs and Jira workflows to enable automated regression runs on feature merges, improving feedback loop times for developers.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies and collaborated with developers and product owners to design testable features and maintain stable test environments.

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
